cohort: The cohort included pregnant women from East China, either experiencing threatened preterm birth between 24 and 28 weeks of gestation (case group) or without such symptoms (control group).
finding: The study found significant imbalances in oral and vaginal microbiota, including decreased lactobacilli, in pregnant women with threatened preterm birth compared to healthy controls, with no significant difference observed in gut microbiota.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, between 24 and 28 weeks of gestation
